mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing the present value of future earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (measured over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (measured over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns are negative when both series exceed 50th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment combined with rising employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS rises (3-month change > 0), or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0% (measured over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, reducing corporate output and profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105 (measured over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year), strong GDP growth (GDPC1) signals economic resilience to inflation, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with strong GDP growth
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% (3-month change), or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) signals inadequate monetary policy response to inflation, increasing stagflation risk and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 200 and FEDFUNDS < 4.5% (measured over 3-year rolling window).
